title: Replication package: Normalisation as implicit re-weighting in multi-criteria portfolio selection: closed form and cost against an exact Pareto frontier

creators.name: Azancort Neto, Julio Leite
creators.affiliation: Instituto de Tecnologia, Universidade Federal do Para (UFPA), Belem, PA, Brazil

description:
Replication package for Normalisation as implicit re-weighting in multi-criteria portfolio selection: closed form and cost against an exact Pareto frontier (under review at Omega, Elsevier).

Contents: (i) input data for 389 admissible landfill sites on Fogo Island, Cabo Verde; (ii) pre-registration documents for six sub-experiments and the main factorial (PRESPEC_E1-E6, PRESPEC_R1, PRESPEC_SANTIAGO); (iii) pre-computed Monte Carlo results (4,000 draws, kappa=200 primary; kappa=50 robustness check); (iv) bootstrap contrast files; (v) Python scripts to reproduce all experiments, bootstrap analyses, LaTeX macros, and manuscript figures; (vi) LaTeX manuscript source (v1.6, post-review editorial revision).

Key finding: Normalisation is the dominant driver of Pareto attainment. Switching from min-max to vector normalisation shifts greedy attainment by +25.4 pp (kappa=200) and +29.2 pp (kappa=50); the SAW-TOPSIS contrast is equivalent to zero at kappa=200 but rises to +20.4 pp at kappa=50.

Changelog v1.6 (2026-10-30): Editorial revision rounds 1-5 applied to manuscript (sections 3-8): kappa chronology corrected; Remark 7 N&S condition clarified; abstract trimmed to 245 words (PDF); highlight character limit enforced; TV macro rounded to 3dp globally; Zenodo concept DOI corrected to 10.5281/zenodo.23676428; Andrade2015 author name and journal corrected; Costa2020 DOI added; Marti2022 corrigendum note restored; structural repetition reduced (sections 6.02, 6.03, 6.09, 6.10).
